title: Sylvan Park  2 mi downtown -
description:
Gorgeous urban home in the heart of Nashville’s “IT” neighborhood. This beautifully renovated home feels like an oasis in the middle of town—modern, welcoming, and thoughtfully curated throughout. Set in a great walkable neighborhood, you can stroll the greenway to Centennial Park, coffee shops, and favorite local restaurants. With three bedrooms, three full baths, a sunroom, lovely living spaces, an inviting patio, and three queen beds this home offers style, comfort, and location all in one.

The space
My space, built in 2015, has been renovated throughout the years with artisan craftsmanship and great attention to detail and fine art.  It's clean, airy, lots of windows ... an urban oasis in the middle of town. Accommodates 7 easily, with three full bathrooms and three queen size beds.

Guest access
If I'm in town I'll greet you and help settle you into my home.  I have apple TV, Netflix, cable, internet, gas range for cooking, a grill in the backyard.
